extracted.intended_audience: Peacock viewers, potential subscribers, and SNL fans
extracted.subtask_description: A promotional/ informational landing page for the television comedy show Saturday Night Live on the Peacock streaming service, listing seasons, episode metadata, cast, and descriptive highlights of the show's style and legacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live sketches, pre-tapes, and musical performances
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete with live sketches, pre-tapes, and musical performances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the show's variety-format: a mix of live and taped sketch comedy plus musical acts. Implies production standards that balance live stage work with pre-recorded material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical humor reflecting politics and current events
rubrics_metrics.description: SNL makes headlines with topical humor reflecting politics and current events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes timeliness and newsworthiness as a comedic criterion—material should engage current political and cultural events to remain relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Array of characters with a perspective on pop culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Features an array of characters with a perspective on pop culture that remains unparalleled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights character-driven comedy and pop-culture commentary as defining qualities; suggests value placed on memorable recurring characters and culturally-aware takes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sharp political commentary via 'Weekend Update'
rubrics_metrics.description: Offers sharp political commentary through its signature 'Weekend Update' segment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies a recurring segment (Weekend Update) as the primary vehicle for political satire and commentary, implying standards for punchy, news-parody writing and delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attracts biggest stars for innovative viral performances
rubrics_metrics.description: Also attracts the biggest stars of music to its stage for innovative viral performances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions high-profile musical guests and staged performances intended to generate viral moments as part of the show's success metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards and historical prestige as quality indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: “SNL” is the most Emmy-winning show in history and holds 113 Emmy wins (including awards for its specials and short form series). “SNL” has been honored four times with the prestigious George Foster Peabody Award and was inducted into the Broadcasting Hall of Fame.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses awards, honors, and longevity to signal quality and cultural impact; these accolades are presented as evidence of excellence and legacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Season and episode technical/content metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Episodes list season/episode numbers, runtime (e.g., 68–70 M), resolution tags (4K UHD, HD, HDR), and TV rating (TV-14).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides standardized episode metadata for viewer expectations and platform delivery; implies consistent episode length and content-rating practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability and live distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Watch new episodes from Season 51 of SNL live on NBC and Peacock on Saturdays at 11:30/10:30c. Peacock is the streaming home of your favorite NBC shows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies platform and broadcast schedule as part of the show's distribution standard; relevant for where and when content must be released to meet audience expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cast and production crediting
rubrics_metrics.description: Starring: [full cast list]. Executive Producer: Lorne Michaels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists principal cast and executive producer to signal the show's personnel profile; continuity and star power of cast/leadership are presented as part of the show's identity and value.
